name: Square Dish with Decoration of a Rampant Dragon Surmounted by the Chinese Character for Longevity (Shou), Set against a Stylized Lotus Arabesque, the Exterior with Stylized Lotus Scroll and Eight Auspicious Emblems
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；Jiajing period, 1522-1566；Porcelain with decoration reserved in white against an overglaze red enamel ground, the pictorial elements articulated with black enamel, and the foliage covered with green enamel; with underglaze cobalt-blue mark reading "Da Ming Jiajing nian zhi" on the base
